terminology_note: The filename is retained for continuity; architecture-family labels are descriptive and are not the primary independence or holdout unit.

dependency_graph.nodes: model_unit_id values, one per independently initialized training run before dependency clustering
dependency_graph.edge_authority: The discovery authorization must carry one content-addressed complete/unambiguous learned-state ancestry record per model plus every external base, teacher, merge-parent, and adapter-base artifact. The validator derives the dependency edge set exactly from declared direct parents and shared parent artifacts; an independently supplied graph cannot add or omit an edge.
dependency_graph.cluster_algorithm: Treat edges as undirected for independence, compute deterministic connected components, sort member model_unit_id values, and assign dependency- plus the first 16 lowercase hex characters of SHA256(NUL-joined sorted members).

outer_split.train_test_constraint: No dependency_cluster_id may occur on both sides of a fold.

pilot_anchor_balance.within_cluster_nuisance_match: All three anchor units in a dependency cluster must share exactly one architecture_family_id, tokenizer_revision, and tokenizer_artifact_sha256. Model artifacts and training configurations remain anchor-specific.
pilot_anchor_balance.learned_state_identity_closure: An identical model_artifact_sha256 is never a second model unit. Repeated lineage_id values must remain within one connected dependency cluster; any cross-cluster repetition fails closed.
pilot_anchor_balance.fold_invariant: Every heldout dependency cluster and every remaining training set contain all three anchor conditions, so dependency-cluster or architecture-family identity cannot alone determine the anchor.

content_seed_partition.unit: semantic_instance_group_id equal to content_seed, including every factor cell, template, source/base pair, and codebook rendering for that seed
content_seed_partition.assignment: Sort unique content seeds by SHA256(split_rule_id || ':' || decimal_content_seed), then allocate positions 0-7 to D_site_discovery, 8-23 to D_causal_label, 24-47 to D_behavior_fit, and 48-63 to D_sealed_test.
content_seed_partition.Q_challenge: Only heldout_challenge projections belonging to D_sealed_test. For each target, aggregate every assigned output into exactly one heldout_cue_conflict slot and one heldout_mismatch_table slot. Raw prompts, seeds, outputs, counts, dependency-cluster keys, and identities remain evaluator-private; auditor-facing target, slot, fold, and development dependency-cluster identifiers are HMAC-derived pseudonyms.
content_seed_partition.cue_mask: Only diagnostic_cue_mask projections belonging to D_sealed_test; their forwards remain zero and pending until all three fold prediction commitments close, and release follows that barrier.
content_seed_partition.template_policy: The globally frozen projection renderers and canonical intervention template are intentionally reused in every content partition; template identity is not an independent split unit and must not be represented as partition-disjoint.
content_seed_partition.overlap_policy: Any semantic_instance_group_id, case_seed_block_id, or source_base_pair_group_id crossing content partitions is a hard error.

probability_calibration.causal_profile: continuous point and interval; probability calibration not applicable
probability_calibration.challenge_response: If categorical probabilities are produced, calibrator fitting is nested inside development dependency clusters and never uses a heldout cluster.
probability_calibration.three_cluster_pilot: Report uncalibrated compatibility scores or prediction sets, not a calibrated posterior.

three_dependency_clusters.permitted: Descriptive transfer was observed on these named dependency clusters.

confirmatory_cross_cluster.minimum: A fresh outcome-naive execution with at least three development dependency clusters and three separately sealed confirmatory dependency clusters.
confirmatory_cross_cluster.additional_requirement: A frozen power simulation may require more than the hard minimum.

discovery_authorization_requirements: content-addressed exact model and tokenizer revisions
content-addressed complete and unambiguous learned-state ancestry inventory
dependency graph derived exactly from ancestry parents and shared artifacts, followed by derived clusters
exact three-anchor balance and nuisance matching inside every dependency cluster
pre-outcome anchor provenance with content-addressed training data and assignment manifest
no duplicate learned-weight artifact and no lineage identity crossing clusters
exact discovery-only pair and candidate-site inventories
exact discovery query plan and bounded wall-clock budget
at least 256-bit operating-system-CSPRNG authority-secret commitment and frozen HMAC derivation ids
final_execution_lock_requirements: exact fold and within-seed partition hashes
preserved operating-system-CSPRNG and HMAC commitments from discovery authorization
prospective scoring-contract and challenge schema hashes
authority_commitments exactly null and no output-derived key, score, or challenge commitment

sealed_evaluation_split_closure.creation_boundary: After the authority supplies the exact regenerated prompt/raw-output inventory and self-addressed ledger declaring 8,064 causal-label, 4,320 behavior-fit, and 4,032 sealed-test forwards (16,416 total) while diagnostics remain zero and pending, create exactly one private post-output sealed authorization per heldout dependency cluster. The ledger is not physical runtime attestation.
sealed_evaluation_split_closure.raw_evidence: Every fold authorization binds the same raw D_sealed_test roots: exactly 2,880 weak and 1,152 challenge trials over all nine targets, from which its opaque heldout surface and scoring material are derived.
sealed_evaluation_split_closure.fold_workers: Exactly three distinct fold-worker capability IDs and no-shared-mount/cache/IPC declarations are required before any reveal. These declarations are audit evidence, not physical isolation attestation; fold-local estimator training/replay remains residual P1.
sealed_evaluation_split_closure.private_identity_boundary: Private authorizations and raw model/dependency-cluster IDs never enter an auditor realm. Development dependency-cluster IDs are domain-separated HMAC pseudonyms.
sealed_evaluation_split_closure.coordinator_closure: fold_runs contain no reveal bytes or nonces. Only after all three commitment/bundle/prediction/redaction and common-root checks close does the coordinator invoke the exact four-field authority opening provider; it proves each fold's development slots and scoring key are the other two folds' heldout material after dependency-cluster IDs are rekeyed into the receiving fold's private HMAC namespace.
sealed_evaluation_split_closure.authority: Single-fold scoring is descriptive and non-authoritative. Candidate and each named baseline are averaged equally across the three heldout clusters before the lower global baseline is selected and the 10-percent gate is applied; diagnostics follow the three-commitment barrier.
